text: Databases store and organise information so we can find it quickly. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, like a spreadsheet. NoSQL databases are more flexible and store data in different ways, such as documents. To get information, we write queries. Data modelling helps us plan how data connects before we build anything. Indexes make searches much faster, especially in large tables. Choosing the right database and designing it well saves time and keeps data accurate.
